id: \bNanu: I got dragged into this. Still, maybe it will be worth a watch.
en: \bNanu: I got dragged into this. Still, maybe it will be worth a watch.
it: \bNanu: Mi ci hanno trascinato. Comunque, forse varrà la pena guardare.

id: \bGuzma: Later, kid. Say hi to Kukui for me.
en: \bGuzma: Later, kid. Say hi to Kukui for me.
it: \bGuzman: Ci si vede, ragazzino. Salutami Kukui.

id: \bCongratulations on winning your third match. \nYour next battle will be on the right.
en: \bCongratulations on winning your third match. \nYour next battle will be on the right.
it: \bCongratulazioni per aver vinto il tuo terzo incontro. \nLa tua prossima lotta si terrà sulla destra.

id: \bGuzma: Heh. I'll beat you down properly this time!
en: \bGuzma: Heh. I'll beat you down properly this time!
it: \bGuzman: Heh. Stavolta ti stendo come si deve!

id: \bGuzma: Hahaha! Don't underestimate my brand of destruction!
en: \bGuzma: Hahaha! Don't underestimate my brand of destruction!
it: \bGuzman: Ahahah! Non sottovalutare il mio marchio di distruzione!
